reviews.x: I was hesitant to purchase this product but so glad I did!! This was so easy to use and took less time to get the gel off my nails! In my picture, this was after I followed the directs, scraped off the gel, and before buffing them smooth.

reviews.t: Hands down (pun intended) the best way to remove Gel polish
reviews.x: Absolute must have if you use gel, shellac, or dip powder on your nails. I've used foil, plastic clamps, rubber tips, even dome finger caps that make each nail look like it's in a little acetone fish bowl but this is by far the most convenient and efficient way to use acetone. Eliminates acetone messes and waste.  Cuts removal time at least in half. Use 100% acentone! I also mix in a little healthy nail additive to my 100% acetone before I use it and still works great. I do my own gel nails.  After a while, I stopped doing them because it was such a pain to remove the gel polish. One day while talking to a coworker who also does nails professionally, she mentioned this gadget.  I knew nothing about steam removers!  I ordered this one.  I absolutely LOVE it and have resumed doing my nails weekly.  It literally takes me about 5 minutes now to remove the polish and doesnt damage my nails.

reviews.t: It works; just have to find the right balance
reviews.x: I've used several times now and found that this works best for us if we use Gelish Artificial Nail Remover (since we use Gelish structure gel and polishes) to break down the polish.  We do take quite a bit of the top layers off before we steam.  I also put my fingers in on the H (heating setting) so that it does get hot and then switches to the steam setting. claims.text: Most reviewers find the steamer works well and makes gel polish removal easier and faster than traditional methods.
Several reviewers note it uses little acetone and avoids the drying and irritation of foil-wrapping.
Some reviewers report defective units that failed to heat, leaked, or melted, and a few received the wrong or missing power cord.
Instructions are lacking or unclear, though reviewers say filing the top coat first is necessary for good results.
Customer service is praised for promptly sending a replacement when the original unit did not turn on.
